frequently asked questions

how do i know if my project is approved?

no matter what, when your project is approved or rejected, you'll get a slack DM from @U0BB0FJU7DM! if you haven't received a DM, it means your project hasn't been reviewed yet. review can take 3-4 weeks!

can we also submit our projects to another game jam, hackathon, or hack club event?

sorry, no! you can keep working on your game after submitting, and submit that to other events, but you can't get rewards twice for the same work, and you can't submit projects not made originally for jame gam. This includes events not run by Hack Club!

how do teams work?

everyone works on the game together and then submits one final game on itch! each person then fills out the jame gam submission form separately. each person who meaningfully contributed gets to pick their own prize! if possible, commit to GitHub separately. also, this rule still applies:

if you're working on a team, you should be putting enough effort in that you could've made your own, smaller game in the same amount of time!

is the game required to be open source? and if that's the case, what do we do about packages that require a license?

it is required! if you have assets like paid marketplace items that you don't want to include in your repo, just make sure they're linked. 

is hackatime required?

hackatime is optional, but it makes your review faster!

can i get a prize just by doing art or music?

yes! however, this rule still applies:

if you're working on a team, you should be putting enough effort in that you could've made your own, smaller game in the same amount of time!

so picking an asset pack, or spending 2 hours drawing, or ai-generating art would be rejected just the same way a game made like that would be rejected. if you put in effort and make something cool, that's fine :)

can i use a tutorial to make my game?

you're welcome to use a tutorial to learn, but the game you submit should be fully custom and far enough from a tutorial that we cant tell at all!

can i use asset packs?

asset packs are allowed, but heavily discouraged! credit everything you didn't make in your game's description.

is AI allowed?

you cannot use AI for any assets (like music, art, or voice lines. this also includes cover art) AI help with code is allowed, but very discouraged! no more than 20% of your code should be written with AI.

for the MFG Gambler's Jam, AI usage is completely disallowed!

how many members can i have in my team?

as many as you want/need! as a general rule to get a prize, each member should put in enough work that they could have made a smaller game on their own.

how do prizes work?

if you submit a game that you put significant effort into, you will get a prize! currently, you have the option to choose one prize from a list, or two indie games from a list. check out jamegam.hackclub.com/prizes!

what do you mean there's no hour requirement? is it guaranteed that everyone gets a prize?.

the idea is that anyone who puts in effort / learns gets a prize, regardless of if they win or if they make a "polished" game! as long as we can see you put in significant effort (by looking at evidence like hackatime, screenshots, local files, screen recordings, videos or otherwise), you'll get a prize.

can I work with someone who's not in hack club?

yes! your game is still required to be open source and they will not receive a prize though (unless you invite them to join hack club ;) )

do I have to use a specific game engine?

we don't have any preferred game engine! however, block coding / visual languages are not allowed for prizes - including Scratch, Blueprints, and GDevelop. Roblox isn't allowed either, since it can't be submitted on itch.io!

how do I submit?

all you have to do during the jam is submit to the itch.io page for the game jam. we'll send out a form to submit to jame gam near when the time runs out, and you'll have 4 days after the jam ends to submit.

how do steam grants work if you are outside of the U.S?

if you're not in the US, you'll either get a code that we buy directly from a third party website so you don't have to go through the trouble, or we'll have you friend the hack club steam account and gift it to you directly. alternatively, you can choose to get reimbursed!

what size is the blåhaj?

full sized! (1 meter)

when does the shop close?

it opens when your game is approved, and it closes 7 days after!

my code is too big to upload to github, what do i do? (i'm using unity)

read this thread on how to solve this!

is it normal for my teammate to receive a dm about the project, but not me?

yes! although teammate's submissions are usually reviewed at the same time, we treat them separately, so it does not mean something has gone wrong.

can I update my game or itch page after the deadline?

depending on the jam, itch.io may not let you make changes after the deadline. you will not be penalized in jame gam for making changes after the deadline, but the submission form will close shortly after the jam ends, and you won't be given a second chance if your game doesn't work when we review it.

i missed the deadline to submit to the jam!

post in #C0BBDUEMF0E with a link to your game, and we'll see what we can do!
